body.name: mesreview
body.title: Manufacturing review advice
body.description: Suggest useful next steps from readable record facts; a person reviews and adopts the result.
body.instructions: Review only the supplied record facts. Explain concrete next steps and missing information. Do not invent inventory, availability, routing capacity, supplier answers, identities or authorization. When the record does not establish the facts needed for a consequential change, category must be review and review must be true. Otherwise category may be routine and review false. Return the declared JSON with a useful summary and confidence between zero and one. This is a proposal; do not claim any action has been executed.

blueprint.guide:
Install into a plain platform tenant and create saved drafts. Grant accountant/controller and the required Core account roles explicitly; installing never grants them. Accounting documents retain accepted business intent. General ledger receipts, numbering, closed-period decisions and reversal remain with Core. Amounts are decimal currency units. Use the normal chart and fiscal-period pages before submitting a journal. Production accounting uses the ordinary Core ledger; the optional demonstration setup declares its own complete example chart. Configure separate stock, work in progress, scrap expense and production variance accounts in a production accounting policy. Grant the production service identity both build:production and Core master-data read access explicitly; installing the package grants neither. Create a finished item and positive material components. Creating a production order freezes the full component structure, cost currency, units, standard unit costs and account references. Later changes apply only to new orders. Each accepted batch consumes materials for good plus scrap, receives good output and keeps scrap/standard-cost differences in the original Core ledger. Negative component inventory is visible as an inventory balance; it is not fabricated as available stock. Business acceptance and Core posting are separate results. An explicit final batch can close a short order while retaining its unproduced quantity.
Publish independently of upstream availability. After installation, configure and check productionupstream before using upstream coordination. Refresh the provider order directory using the normal mesproductionplans Source action before selecting an upstream order; the directory is a proposal and ERP still checks its live remaining quantity. Report actual terminal batches from the shop order, with final selected only when all local batches are terminal. An unknown delivery stays on its original request and batch key. Only a conclusive provider refusal allows a supervisor to select a matching replacement order and enter a reason. Correct creates a linked attempt, preserves the original upstream association and physical good/scrap, starts the replacement and reports the same physical batch identity. Never acknowledge confirmation-only completion actions by hand.
The package includes synthetic work-center/resource samples and three portable business plans. Choose a supervisor for assembly and machining planning trials, and an accountant with Core access for decimal accounting. Trials run in the selected candidate and do not initialize live data. Create actual configuration with the normal business pages; installation and restart do not seed it. Assembly and machining may use separate work centers, resources, capability requirements and published routing versions. Existing batches retain their selected routing version. To upgrade, add an optional field and change an action title on the original object draft, check the candidate and confirm its upgrade plan; publish a new routing version for new orders instead of editing released operation instructions. / 生产订单创建时冻结组件、标准成本、单位、币种及科目，后续主数据修改只影响新订单。通过原 Core 页面配置生产在制、报废和差异科目，并显式授予生产服务 Core 主数据读取权限。安装发布不依赖上游；安装后在使用上游协同前配置并检查 productionupstream，密钥只填写部署名称 production-upstream。首个实际开工批次经 Flow 与 Confirmation 发起上游开工；现场完工或质量双签报废后，主管在工单选择实际批次报工，良品和报废数量取自现场记录。全部本地批次结束后才可声明终结上游，短产的剩余量继续保留。未知答复按原租户、工单和批次身份回读，拒绝及人工复核保留独立结果，不改写现场事实。库存只由 erpstock 与 erpmove 承担，业务接受和 Core 记账分别显示。 / 刷新上游订单目录后再选择关联；ERP 仍按实时剩余量裁决。未知答复先核对原请求，只有确定拒绝后主管才能填写原因并选择匹配替代订单，新尝试关联原记录且保留实际良品和报废。不得手工调用确认专用完成动作。包内提供合成工作中心与资源样本，以及装配、加工计划和小数凭证验收计划；分别选择主管和具备 Core 权限的会计运行隔离候选试验。样本不会自动写入业务租户。通过正常业务页面配置工作中心、能力与工艺版本；在途批次固定原工艺。新增可选字段和修改动作标题须经原候选升级计划，新订单选择新工艺版本，不直接改已发布工序。 Equipment observations use the independent mesobservations connection. Configure its state-store address and /observations adapter before using the interval source; its declaration can be published while the environment is unconfigured. Create equipment with a source device identifier and a supervising unit in the site structure. That unit and its ancestors must have explicit supervisor memberships and Build business grants. The state condition defaults to down and is editable; raw samples remain in the external store. A zero reminder disables overdue reminders; clearing Request a downtime reason suppresses the work request.
